resources.string: Offer the log for download on this network?
Nixie closed unexpectedly on %1$s. Offer its log for download on this network?
Shows a code: scan it with a phone to open Nixie for TV\'s report form on GitHub, with the app\'s and the server\'s versions filled in. Nothing is sent from this TV.
Scan the code with a phone. It opens the Report a problem form on GitHub, with this app\'s and the server\'s versions filled in.
Say what happened and how to make it happen again.
To add the log, close this page, choose Download log on the network, and drag the file the phone saves into the form.
Nothing is sent from this TV: the form opens on the phone, and you send it from there. Leave server addresses, user names and passwords out of it.
